notes.title: Version 1.2 is already available!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33890535/c72ebde72907c1113079aa87597bdd3a1846a33d.jpg[/img]

Hi folks,

We've been working on a game update based mainly on your feedback and we've implemented some improvements on the player's control. We know this is important for you and that's why we've focused on it.

Patch notes:
─ Now PS4 controller is fully compatible.
─ Camera sensibility range has been adjusted for mouse control.
─ Automatic camera has been removed from the "Surf" mechanics if you play with mouse & keyboard.

We'll keep updating Effie, so if you find a bug or you want to give us some feedback, please let us know in the game discussions.

See you in Oblena! ːsteamhappyː

https://store.steampowered.com/app/975950/Effie/
